subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Bird communities in two forest fragments
stimulus.description: Equal-area surveys were carried out using the same method.

question: Evaluate the statement that the two forest fragments have the same biodiversity because both contain four bird species.
markscheme: Both fragments have the same species richness because four species were recorded in each.
Fragment A has much greater evenness because abundances are similar among the four species.
Fragment B is dominated by species Z, which accounts for 76 of 100 birds.
Biodiversity includes more than species richness, so equal richness does not mean the communities have the same diversity.
A stronger comparison would include repeated surveys, additional taxa or a diversity index that incorporates abundance.
markschemeJa: 両地点とも4種が記録されており、種数は同じである。
Aでは4種の個体数が近く、均等度が高い。
BではZ種が100個体中76個体を占め、大きく優占している。
生物多様性は種数だけでなく相対的な個体数も関係するため、種数が同じでも多様性が同じとは限らない。
反復調査、他の分類群の調査、個体数を含む多様度指数などを用いると比較が強化される。
modelAnswer: Both fragments contain four species, so their species richness is the same. However, Fragment A is much more even, with about 23–28 individuals of each species, whereas Fragment B is dominated by species Z with 76 individuals. Therefore the statement is not well supported: biodiversity cannot be judged from richness alone. Repeated sampling and a diversity index that includes relative abundance would provide stronger evidence.
modelAnswerJa: 両地点とも4種なので種数は同じです。しかしAでは各種の個体数がほぼ均等なのに対し、BではZ種が76%を占めています。したがって「4種いるから多様性も同じ」とは言えません。反復調査や相対個体数を含む多様度指数を使うと、より強い比較になります。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Distribution along a shore transect
stimulus.description: Quadrats were placed at equal intervals from the low-tide mark.
stimulus.note: Other environmental variables were not measured.

question: Analyse the relationship between salinity and the abundance of species P, and state one limitation of concluding that salinity alone determines its distribution.
markscheme: Species P is most abundant where salinity is relatively high, with 18–20 individuals per quadrat at 31–35 salinity units.
Abundance decreases as salinity decreases beyond the first two sampling positions.
At salinity 12, only one individual per quadrat is recorded.
The data show an association between salinity and abundance but do not demonstrate that salinity is the cause.
Other variables along the shore, such as exposure, substrate, competition or desiccation, were not measured or controlled.
markschemeJa: P種は塩分が高い31〜35付近で1区画18〜20個体と最も多い。
最初の2地点以降は塩分低下に伴って個体数も減少している。
塩分12では1区画あたり1個体しかいない。
このデータは塩分と個体数の関連を示すが、塩分が原因だとは証明していない。
波当たり、基質、競争、乾燥など他の環境要因を測定・統制していない。
modelAnswer: Species P is most abundant at the high-salinity end of the transect and its abundance generally declines as salinity falls, reaching only one individual per quadrat at the lowest salinity. This suggests an association with salinity. However, the transect also changes in many other environmental factors, so the data cannot show that salinity alone causes the distribution.
modelAnswerJa: P種は高塩分側で最も多く、塩分が下がるにつれて概ね個体数も減り、最低塩分では1個体まで低下しています。ただし、岸の位置とともに他の環境要因も変化するため、塩分だけが分布を決めるとは結論できません。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Growth of two protist species
stimulus.description: Each species was grown alone and together with the other species under identical resource conditions.
stimulus.note: Initial population sizes were equal when both species were cultured together.

question: Deduce what the results suggest about competition between the two species and explain the relevance of ecological niches.
markscheme: Both species can reach large populations when grown alone, so the culture conditions can support either species.
When grown together, species Y is greatly reduced to 90 while species X remains relatively high at 690.
The results suggest that X is the stronger competitor under these conditions.
Strong competition indicates substantial overlap in resource use or ecological niche.
The experiment does not show that complete competitive exclusion must occur in every natural environment because real ecosystems contain additional resources and conditions.
markschemeJa: 単独培養では両種とも大きな個体群に達するため、この環境はどちらの種も支えられる。
混合培養ではYが90まで大きく減少し、Xは690と比較的高い。
この条件ではXの方が競争力が高いと考えられる。
強い競争は資源利用やニッチの重なりが大きいことを示唆する。
自然環境では資源や条件がより複雑なため、この結果だけで常に完全な競争排除が起こるとは言えない。
modelAnswer: Both species grow well alone, but when they are grown together species Y falls to 90 while X remains at 690. This suggests that X competes more successfully for the limiting resources under these conditions. The strong effect implies overlap in their niches. However, the laboratory result does not prove that Y would always be excluded in nature, where additional resources and environmental variation may allow niche separation.
modelAnswerJa: 単独では両種ともよく増えますが、混合するとYは90まで減り、Xは690を維持しています。この条件ではXが限られた資源をより有利に利用していると考えられ、ニッチの重なりが大きいことを示唆します。ただし自然界では条件が複雑なので、必ずYが排除されるとは限りません。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Heart rate after exercise
stimulus.description: A student completed three minutes of exercise and then sat quietly.
stimulus.note: Resting heart rate before exercise was 70 beats min⁻¹.

question: Analyse the data and explain how coordination between body systems helps restore conditions toward the resting state.
markscheme: Heart rate decreases progressively from 154 beats min⁻¹ immediately after exercise to 72 beats min⁻¹ after 10 minutes.
The final value is close to the pre-exercise resting heart rate of 70 beats min⁻¹.
During recovery, reduced metabolic demand lowers the need for rapid oxygen delivery and carbon dioxide removal.
Sensory information and control centres in the nervous system can alter autonomic signals to the heart.
Negative-feedback regulation moves the controlled variable back toward its normal range rather than amplifying the deviation.
markschemeJa: 心拍数は運動直後154回/分から10分後72回/分まで段階的に低下している。
10分後の値は運動前の安静時70回/分に近い。
回復時には代謝需要が低下し、酸素供給や二酸化炭素除去を高速度で行う必要性も下がる。
感覚情報と中枢の調節により、自律神経から心臓への信号が変化する。
負のフィードバックは偏差を増幅するのではなく、値を通常範囲へ戻す方向に働く。
modelAnswer: Heart rate falls steadily from 154 beats min⁻¹ to 72 beats min⁻¹ over ten minutes, approaching the resting value of 70. As exercise ends, muscle metabolic demand decreases. The nervous system integrates information about internal conditions and adjusts autonomic output to the heart, reducing cardiac activity. This is consistent with negative feedback returning the system toward its normal range.
modelAnswerJa: 心拍数は10分間で154から72回/分まで下がり、安静時70回/分に近づいています。運動終了後は筋肉の代謝需要が低下し、神経系が体内状態を統合して心臓への自律神経信号を調節します。これは負のフィードバックによって正常範囲へ戻る例です。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Vaccination coverage and disease incidence
stimulus.description: Four similar districts reported vaccination coverage and annual disease incidence.
stimulus.note: The table is observational; other differences among districts were not measured.

question: Evaluate the conclusion that higher vaccination coverage reduces disease incidence.
markscheme: Disease incidence decreases across the table as vaccination coverage increases.
The district with 94% coverage has the lowest incidence, 18 cases per 100 000.
The district with 52% coverage has the highest incidence, 184 cases per 100 000.
The pattern is consistent with vaccination reducing the number of susceptible hosts and transmission.
Because the data are observational, other differences among districts could contribute, so the table alone does not prove causation.
markschemeJa: ワクチン接種率が高くなるほど疾患発生率は低下している。
接種率94%の地区Dは10万人あたり18例と最も少ない。
接種率52%の地区Aは10万人あたり184例と最も多い。
接種によって感受性宿主が減り、感染伝播が抑えられるという説明と一致する。
観察データなので、地区間の他の違いも影響し得るため、この表だけでは因果関係を証明できない。
modelAnswer: The data show a strong negative association: incidence falls from 184 to 18 cases per 100 000 as vaccination coverage rises from 52% to 94%. This is consistent with vaccination reducing susceptibility and transmission. However, the data are observational, and other differences among districts could affect incidence. The evidence supports the conclusion but does not by itself prove causation.
modelAnswerJa: 接種率が52%から94%へ上がるにつれて、発生率は184から18例/10万人へ低下しており、強い負の関連があります。これは接種により感受性宿主や伝播が減るという考えと一致します。ただし観察研究なので、他の地区差も影響し得ます。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Capture-mark-release-recapture survey
stimulus.description: Researchers captured, marked and released animals. A second sample was taken after mixing.
stimulus.note: Assume marked animals mixed randomly and marking did not affect survival or capture probability.

question: Calculate the estimated population size using the Lincoln index and explain two assumptions that must be reasonably satisfied for the estimate to be valid.
markscheme: Estimated population size = (60 × 75) ÷ 15 = 300 individuals.
Marked individuals must have mixed randomly back into the population before the second capture.
Marking should not substantially change survival or the probability of recapture.
There should be little immigration, emigration, birth or death between sampling events.
Marked animals should retain their marks and marks should be recognized correctly.
markschemeJa: 標識個体が2回目の捕獲前に集団へ十分ランダムに混ざっている必要がある。
標識によって生存率や再捕獲される確率が大きく変化してはならない。
2回の捕獲の間に移入・移出・出生・死亡が少ないことが望ましい。
標識が失われず、正確に識別される必要がある。
modelAnswer: Using the Lincoln index, the estimated population is (60 × 75) ÷ 15 = 300 individuals. The estimate assumes that marked animals mix back into the population and have approximately the same chance of capture as unmarked animals. It also works best when population size changes little between samples and when marks are not lost.
modelAnswerJa: リンカーン指数より推定個体数は(60×75)÷15=300個体です。この方法では、標識個体が集団に十分混ざり、未標識個体と同程度に捕獲されること、2回の調査間で個体数が大きく変化しないこと、標識が失われないことなどが前提になります。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Offspring from a monohybrid cross
stimulus.description: Two heterozygous plants for a single gene were crossed. The dominant phenotype was purple and the recessive phenotype was white.
stimulus.note: A simple dominant-recessive model predicts a 3:1 phenotype ratio.

question: Analyse whether the observed results are consistent with the expected 3:1 ratio and explain why exact agreement is not required.
markscheme: There are 200 offspring in total.
A 3:1 ratio predicts about 150 purple and 50 white offspring.
The observed values, 148 purple and 52 white, are close to the expected values.
Random segregation and fertilization can cause sampling variation around the theoretical ratio.
A statistical test such as chi-squared could be used to assess whether the deviation is larger than expected by chance.
markschemeJa: 子は合計200個体である。
3:1なら紫約150、白約50が期待される。
観察値148紫・52白は期待値に近い。
対立遺伝子の分離や受精は確率的なので、理論比から標本変動が生じる。
カイ二乗検定などで、ずれが偶然で説明できる範囲かを評価できる。
modelAnswer: There are 200 offspring, so a 3:1 ratio predicts approximately 150 purple and 50 white. The observed counts of 148 and 52 are very close to these expectations and are therefore consistent with the model. Exact agreement is not required because segregation and fertilization are random processes. A chi-squared test could be used for a formal comparison.
modelAnswerJa: 合計200個体なので3:1なら紫150、白50が期待されます。観察値148と52は非常に近く、単純な優性・劣性モデルと整合します。分離や受精には偶然性があるため、理論比と完全一致する必要はありません。

subject: Biology SL

stimulus.title: Lake conditions after nutrient enrichment
stimulus.description: Measurements were taken before and after increased nutrient runoff entered a lake.

question: Explain the pattern in the data in terms of eutrophication.
markscheme: Nitrate concentration increases substantially after nutrient enrichment.
Algal biomass increases strongly following the rise in nutrient availability.
Large algal growth can produce more dead organic matter when algae die.
Decomposer respiration increases while breaking down the added organic matter, increasing biochemical oxygen demand.
Dissolved oxygen therefore falls markedly, reaching 2.6 mg L⁻¹ by month 3, which can stress or kill aerobic organisms.
markschemeJa: 栄養塩流入後、硝酸塩濃度が大きく上昇している。
栄養塩増加に続いて藻類バイオマスが大きく増加している。
大量増殖した藻類が死ぬと、有機物が増える。
分解者がその有機物を分解する際の呼吸が増え、生物化学的酸素要求量が高まる。
その結果、溶存酸素が月3には2.6 mg/Lまで低下し、好気性生物に悪影響を与える。
modelAnswer: Nutrient enrichment raises nitrate concentration and is followed by a large increase in algal biomass. When this increased biomass dies, decomposers break down the organic matter and respire more. This raises oxygen demand and causes dissolved oxygen to fall from 8.7 to 2.6 mg L⁻¹. The sequence is consistent with eutrophication and can lead to hypoxic conditions for aquatic animals.
modelAnswerJa: 栄養塩流入で硝酸塩が増え、藻類バイオマスが急増しています。その後、死んだ藻類を分解者が分解すると呼吸量が増え、酸素需要が高まります。そのため溶存酸素は8.7から2.6 mg/Lまで低下し、富栄養化に伴う低酸素状態が生じます。
